encryption: WebRTC DTLS bound by pairwise Signal-authenticated SDP; no custom AES in these frames
limits_note: Codec vectors are not file-policy limits. State must additionally bind size, role, consent, attempt, ownership, contiguous offset and durability.

semantic_adversarial_cases.required: Reject chunk; no connection/file created until local explicit consent.
Old connection callback cannot write, ACK or update attempt2 state.
Terminal cancel persists across restart; acceptance cannot revive transfer.
Exactly one receiver device wins atomic claim; sender pins that same device.
Display passive offer; do not open source/connection or send duplicate offer.
Reject without overflow, file write, ACK or progress mutation.
Reject noncontiguous chunk; never allocate sparse file to attacker offset.
No durable ACK or persisted forward offset; close/pause with owned partial retained.
Do not ACK uncommitted bytes; resume only prior persisted durable prefix.
No ACK; restart verifies/truncates to last persisted durable offset.
Reject impossible ACK in current negotiated attempt; no sender progress skip.
No rollback; duplicate is harmless and cannot renew deadlines indefinitely.
Reject finalization even when supplied digest equals authenticated offer.
No completed state, rename, auto-open or complete ACK.
Reconcile completed transfer idempotently; no second file or full retransmission.
Reject changed source; new original requires a new logical offer and consent.
Verify prefix before resume; reset safely/reconfirm, never trust length alone.
Old ownership epoch cannot write in new account, ACK or publish state.
Reject before remote description or bytes; no TURN fallback.
Do not infer directness or send original bytes; bounded retry then explicit failure.
Persistent signal-id dedup before ratchet decrypt; no duplicate side effect or decrypt-error loop.
Atomic durable Signal/control handling or recoverable protocol resend with fresh signal ID; cannot silently lose accepted state.

claim_boundary: Independent Python wire oracle and fixture generation only. Native production codecs, Signal/RTC interop, disk races and physical FPS have not been exercised by this script.
